lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Census 2011 residents on each hex, from the district total.

lenses.name: Density
lenses.description: Residents per square kilometre of district area. A district average: a city inside a rural district reads lower than it is.

lenses.name: Literacy
lenses.description: Effective literacy rate: literates as a share of the population aged 7 and over.

lenses.name: Urban
lenses.description: Share of the district population living in statutory towns and census towns.

lenses.name: Scheduled Castes
lenses.description: Share of the population that is Scheduled Caste.

lenses.name: Scheduled Tribes
lenses.description: Share of the population that is Scheduled Tribe. High across central India's tribal belt and the Northeast.

lenses.name: Farm workers
lenses.description: Cultivators and agricultural labourers as a share of all workers.

lenses.name: Household industry
lenses.description: Household industry workers as a share of all workers: the artisan and handloom economy.

lenses.name: Growth 2001-11
lenses.description: Population change between the 2001 and 2011 censuses.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Forest cover as a share of the district's land, from the India State of Forest Report 2023, averaged over its hexes.

lenses.name: Cropland
lenses.description: Modelled cropland share, built from state net sown area and terrain.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Modelled built-up share of the hex.

lenses.name: Elevation
lenses.description: Mean elevation of the district's hexes, sampled from the Terrarium global elevation tiles (SRTM/ASTER/ETOPO1).

lenses.name: Workforce
lenses.description: Workers (main and marginal) as a share of the population.
